visualReview.notes: Inspected all seven final portable views against the two primary Qualla originals and supplemental eastern gable photograph. Three brick floors, seven-bay gables, nine-bay long sides, white pilasters/cornices, large fanlights and paired oculi, slate gable roof, east-end cupola and grasshopper remain identifiable. Rejected initial gable occlusion was corrected by separating the roof overhang from the gable plane. Open lantern arch spandrels were added before final captures.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all seven final shared views including the north-up placement overlay. Brick, plain concrete, slate and painted metal retain metric UVs; glazing stays portable. The mapped hall outline and separate east-end tower parts agree with the model. Source/runtime transform, reference-point sampling, resource unload and material-graph reads pass. Fine stone carving and physical gold reflectance are simplified.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected all nineteen final medium-fi views, including both lights/quality modes, front/back, silhouette and forced LODs. Open cupola posts now persist in skyline instead of the rejected dark closed lantern. Window rhythm and three floor bands retain legibility at block distance; small trim and grasshopper details simplify at distant levels. Synthetic neighboring blocks are a style test, not downtown Boston. No physical-device performance claim.

fidelityReview.scope: Historic Faneuil Hall exterior, roof, cupola and simplified grasshopper weather vane; adjacent markets and interiors excluded.
fidelityReview.notes: Accepted original medium-fi historic Faneuil Hall exterior. The 2025 Ajay Suresh whole western gable/side view, Robert Linsdell lantern detail and supplemental Eric Kilby eastern gable establish the visible exterior. Main proportions, fanlights, white bands, roof/cupola relationship and insect weather-vane silhouette are retained. Detailed capitals, exact pane counts, access ramps, plaques, unseen roof services and interiors are omitted or simplified. Quincy Market is excluded. Reference photography is not redistributed.

runtimeLodReview.notes: All four current hash-bound levels pass strict budgets and were visually inspected. Counts: skyline 818, district 3948, street 14532, closeup 17196. Skyline/district/street are authored; district keeps the facade rhythm using shallow trim planes. Error limits are declared authoring budgets, not independent mesh-distance measurements.

geometryValidation.notes: Exact source regeneration, ordinary import verification, four current LOD checks and strict medium-fi audit passed. Source bundle, scene and terrain schemas pass; terrain PNG round-trip error is recorded above. No independent Khronos-validator run is claimed.

limitations: Original medium-fi exterior from inspected local Qualla photographs and generalized hall/cupola footprints; not a measured architectural survey.

Facade bay rhythm, arched fanlights, pilasters, cornices, gables, open lantern and grasshopper silhouette are retained. Fine Corinthian ornament, pane counts, access ramps, plaques and hidden roof service details are simplified.
Only historic Faneuil Hall is included. Quincy Market, neighboring market buildings, plaza furniture and interiors are excluded.
Height estimates and entrance datum are photographic/map interpretations. Other host elevation datasets may require a new placement review.
Reference photography remains in Qualla; no photos are embedded or redistributed in the runtime pack.
